title: VISH-ASR: Viterbi-Guided Selection of Hotwords for Speech-LLM Contextual ASR
abstract: arXiv:2610.27867v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prompt-based contextual ASR requires selecting a compact hotword subset from large dynamic inventories, yet existing pre-selection methods rely either on discrete ASR hypotheses that may discard acoustic evidence or on separately trained retrieval models. We propose Viterbi-guided Selection of Hotwords (VISH), a training-free, plug-and-play framework that directly verifies candidate-specific acoustic support over frame-level CTC posteriors. VISH formulates pre-selection as constrained posterior search; M-VISH makes large-list verification scalable through frame-synchronous shared-prefix Viterbi search with bounded top-K pruning, while Bi-MVISH exploits complementary backward evidence for robust verification. Across five benchmarks, M-VISH achieves up to 11.7% absolute improvement in Best-F1 over a strong learned-retrieval baseline and reduces candidate-search latency by 75.2% at 2,000 candidates relative to hypothesis-based filtering.

translated_title: VISH-ASR：基于维特比引导的热词选择，面向语音-LLM上下文感知语音识别
translated_abstract: 基于提示词的上下文感知语音识别（ASR）需要从大型动态词库中选择一个紧凑的热词子集，然而现有的预选择方法要么依赖于可能丢弃声学证据的离散ASR识别假设，要么依赖于单独训练的检索模型。我们提出了维特比引导的热词选择方法（VISH），这是一个无需训练、即插即用的框架，可在帧级CTC后验概率上直接验证特定候选词的声学支持度。VISH将预选择问题形式化为受约束的后验搜索；M-VISH通过带边界top-K剪枝的帧同步共享前缀维特比搜索，使大规模词表的验证具备可扩展性，而Bi-MVISH则利用互补的反向证据实现更稳健的验证。在五个基准测试中，M-VISH相比强大的已训练检索基线在Best-F1指标上取得了高达11.7%的绝对提升，并且在2,000个候选词的条件下，相比基于假设的过滤方法将候选搜索延迟降低了75.2%。
tldr: 本文提出无需训练、即插即用的热词预选择框架VISH，通过在帧级CTC后验上进行受约束的维特比搜索直接验证候选词的声学支持度，在五个基准上Best-F1最高提升11.7%，并将候选搜索延迟降低75.2%。
en_tdlr: VISH is a training-free, plug-and-play hotword pre-selection framework that directly verifies candidate-specific acoustic support via constrained Viterbi search over frame-level CTC posteriors, achieving up to 11.7% absolute Best-F1 improvement and 75.2% candidate-search latency reduction across five benchmarks.
